results.description: JOHANNESBURG: Over 500 people in South Africa have fallen ill from a gastrointestinal illness that causes stomach cramps and diarrhea, which authorities are blaming on poor water quality in two different cities in the country. Authorities this week issued a warning to communities east of the capital, Pretoria, to stop drinking water from their taps after 408 people including children fell ill and were treated at various health facilities. results.title: Forrester's 2027 B2B Go-To-Market Predictions: AI Agents Will Influence 75% Of B2B Purchase Decisions
results.description: To remain competitive, providers must strengthen customer trust, substantiate value claims, and offer human expertise and guidance SINGAPORE, Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- According to Forrester's (Nasdaq: FORR) 2027 B2B go-to-market predictions, business buyers will increasingly deploy AI agents to handle tasks across the buying process, from supplier discovery and information gathering to contract-renewal analysis. While truly autonomous buying will remain concentrated in high-volume, low-risk, and repeatable purchases, the ubiquity of these agents will require providers to ensure that their systems and sellers can respond with speed, accuracy, and consistency. Forrester's B2B Predictions reports, covering topics including B2B go-to-market strategy, business buyers, and content and creative, offer forward-looking insights to help executives and their teams anticipate change, reduce uncertainty, and make confident decisions ahead of market shifts. Key highlights from the 2027 B2B go-to-market predictions include: Buyers will double their human interactions to validate AI-generated recommendations. As AI becomes the primary interface for researching products and providers, buyers will encounter more AI-generated recommendations, synthetic content, automated outreach, and agent-mediated interactions. Since AI cannot fully judge service provider fit, feasibility, trust, or accountability, buyers will require conversations with provider teams and trusted third parties including analysts, customer references, and partners to confirm and validate buying decisions. Two-thirds of providers will lose deals because buyers cannot verify claims. Buyers already use AI-assisted search and analysis tools to gather information about products and vendors, synthesize provider claims, and fact check. As the reliance on these capabilities continue to advance, go-to-market teams will need to act fast to restructure content discovery for AI tools, including providing credible and consistent proof points that AI tools can index and validate. Most CMOs will cut programs or accept reduced capacity after overestimating AI gains. As pressure intensifies to reduce personnel costs with AI, marketing leaders will eliminate as many as 25% of roles in anticipation of productivity gains that fail to meet expectations. As a result, they will have to choose between cutting program budgets to restore capacity through rehiring, contractors, or agency support or accept reduced execution with a smaller team. In either case, lower campaign investment, weaker execution, or both will reduce marketing's overall value contribution. "In 2027, the defining challenge for B2B go-to-market leaders will be to make deliberate choices about what to automate and where human judgment still matters," said Sharyn Leaver, chief research officer at Forrester. "As AI becomes ubiquitous across the buying process, B2B leaders that pair AI-driven speed and convenience with transparency, control, and trust will extract the most value from AI." Resources: Download Forrester's 2027 Predictions guide for B2B go-to-market. Register for Forrester's webinar exploring the key trends reshaping B2B go-to-market strategies in 2027. Learn how to turn these predictions into action through Forrester's global B2B events and research programs. About Forrester Forrester (Nasdaq: FORR) is one of the most influential research and advisory firms in the world. We empower leaders in technology, customer experience, digital, marketing, revenue, and product functions to make confident decisions in an AI-driven world and accelerate growth through customer obsession. Our unique research and continuous guidance model helps executives and their teams achieve their initiatives and outcomes faster and with confidence. To learn more, visit Forrester.com.

results.title: NUH WINS GOLD AT IHF AWARDS 2026 FOR GREEN OPERATING THEATRE PROGRAMME
results.description: NUH won Gold and received an Honourable Mention for its sustainability efforts at the International Hospital Federation Awards 2026, alongside presentations of its green surgical initiatives, digital health and organisational improvement initiatives at the World Hospital Congress. SINGAPORE, Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The National University Hospital (NUH) has won the Gold Award (Low Carbon Healthcare) for its Green Operating Theatre programme at the International Hospital Federation (IHF) Awards 2026. The hospital also received an Honourable Mention (Hospital Sustainability Acceleration) for its system-wide approach to embedding sustainability across healthcare delivery and hospital operations. The awards were presented at the 49th World Hospital Congress in Seoul, where NUH is also sharing other initiatives in environmental sustainability, digital health and organisational improvement. Professor Aymeric Lim, Chief Executive Officer of NUH, said: "Healthcare must become more sustainable without compromising patient care. Our teams have shown that simple, practical changes on the ground, from the way we run our operating theatres to how we use resources, can make a real difference. This recognition belongs to the multi-disciplinary teams and partners who turned ideas into everyday practice, and who continue to improve how we care for our patients." Advancing low-carbon healthcare by reducing the environmental impact of surgical care NUH's Green Operating Theatre (OT) programme began with efforts to reduce the use of high-carbon anaesthetic gases. What started as a targeted decarbonisation initiative has since grown into a hospital-wide programme that brings together clinicians, nurses, operations teams and facilities staff to drive sustainability across surgical practices, resource use, waste management and energy management. The programme has achieved a 99 per cent reduction in the use of desflurane, a high-carbon anaesthetic gas, and delivered annual energy savings of about 660,000 kWh by optimising operating theatre ventilation during non-operating hours. Surgical teams redesigned instrument sets used for high-volume knee replacement procedures to better reflect routine requirements, reducing emissions by almost 10,000 kg CO2e annually while also cutting water use and sterilisation workload. Efforts have also been made to reduce unnecessary consumables and expand medical recycling streams. Collectively, these initiatives have generated valuable insights that NUH has actively shared through inter-cluster platforms and collaborations, helping to inform the adoption of low-carbon practices across Singapore's public healthcare system. Embedding sustainability into everyday healthcare delivery NUH received an Honourable Mention for its organisation-wide approach to embedding sustainability into hospital planning and operations. Guided by the IHF Sustainability Accelerator Tool, NUH integrated sustainability into leadership oversight, strategic planning and everyday decision-making, strengthening efforts in Appropriate Value-based Care, virtual care, procurement, workforce engagement and environmental stewardship. This system-wide approach to advancing a sustainable healthcare system has been recognised internationally. In 2025, NUH became the first hospital worldwide to receive the Joint Commission International-Geneva Sustainability Centre's Healthcare Sustainability Certification. This year, it was the only hospital in Singapore to be accorded the highest 5-Leaf distinction in Newsweek-Statista's World's Greenest Hospitals index. A new model of rehabilitation care Recognised as one of the top three healthcare innovations selected for the International Hospital Federation's i-to-i Innovation Hub Awards 2026, the NUH Virtual Rehabilitation Centre (VRC) is helping to extend rehabilitation beyond hospital walls. Developed as a virtual-first rehabilitation ecosystem, the VRC combines personalised patient education, self-management tools, AI-enabled telerehabilitation, remote monitoring and digital rehabilitation pathways to support patients throughout their recovery journey. By enabling rehabilitation to continue beyond traditional clinic visits, the VRC improves access to care, strengthens patient participation in recovery and allows therapists to focus their attention on patients with more complex rehabilitation needs. The digital home exercise programme, for instance, supports around 2,000 patients and records about 21,000 logins each month, freeing up the equivalent of 66 physiotherapist workdays annually for direct patient care. The innovation demonstrates how technology can be used not simply to digitise existing services, but to transform how rehabilitation is delivered at scale. Helping doctors work smarter with electronic medical records NUH also presented results from its Great Epic Transformation (GET) programme at the 49th World Hospital Congress in Seoul. The hospital-wide programme trained specialist doctors to personalise their Epic electronic medical record (EMR) workflows, using customised note templates, order sets and shortcuts to work more efficiently. Nine months after training, participating doctors spent 10.2 per cent less time in the EMR each day, equivalent to more than 33 hours saved per doctor annually, while time spent placing orders fell by 26.5 per cent. Twelve of 13 efficiency measures improved across both medical and surgical specialties. Based on annual estimates, the overall efficiency gains are valued at more than S$91 million a year. The programme is being extended to allied health professionals and pharmacists across NUHS, with a target of reaching more than 2,000 healthcare professionals by the end of 2026. About the National University Hospital (NUH) The National University Hospital (NUH) is Singapore's university hospital. While the hospital at Kent Ridge first received its patients on 24 June 1985, our legacy started from 1905, the date of the founding of what is today the NUS Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine. NUH is the principal teaching hospital of the medical school. Our unique identity as a university hospital is a key attraction for healthcare professionals who aspire to do more than practise tertiary medical care. We offer an environment where research and teaching are an integral part of medicine, and continue to shape medicine and transform care for the community we care for. We are an academic medical centre with over 1,200 beds, serving more than one million patients a year with over 50 medical, surgical and dental specialties. NUH is the only public and not-for-profit hospital in Singapore to provide trusted care for adults, women and children under one roof, including the only paediatric kidney and liver transplant programme in the country. The NUH is a key member of the National University Health System (NUHS), one of three public healthcare clusters in Singapore. For more information, visit www.nuh.com.sg Follow us on Facebook | Instagram | LinkedIn | TikTok | YouTube

results.title: Axaipay Partner with Incomedia to Launch 'AxaiCart+', a Combined E-Commerce and Website Building Solution
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia, Oct. 22, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Axaipay, a premier digital payment service provider, today announced a strategic partnership has officially announced a strategic partnership with Incomedia, the developers behind the renowned website creation software WebSite X5. Together, they are launching AxaiCart+, an all-in-one bundled solution designed to empower micro, small and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) and entrepreneurs to build, manage, and scale their online businesses seamlessly. AxaiCart+ combines the robust, secure payment processing capabilities of Axaipay with the professional, desktop-based website design power of WebSite X5 Pro. This synergy addresses a major pain point for growing businesses: the complexity of integrating secure checkout systems with high-performing, customized e-commerce websites. Key Features of AxaiCart+ All-in-One E-Commerce Ecosystem: A seamless blend of WebSite X5 Pro's advanced design tools and Axaipay's secure payment gateway. Zero Coding Required: Businesses can launch professional, mobile-responsive online stores using WebSite X5 Pro's intuitive drag-and-drop builder. Localized & Global Payments: Integrated access to Axaipay's diverse payment options, including credit/debit cards, internet banking (FPX), TNG eWallet, ShopeePay, Boost eWallet and DuitNow QR. Enhanced SEO & Speed: WebSite X5 Pro generates clean, optimized code to ensure fast loading times and high search engine visibility, driving organic traffic to stores. Cost-Effective Scalability: Unlike traditional SaaS platforms with recurring high monthly fees per listing, AxaiCart+ provides a highly cost-efficient model for independent hosting ownership. Driving Digital Transformation "Our goal has always been to simplify the digital journey for businesses," said Dr. Terry Yee, CEO of Axaipay. "By partnering with Incomedia to create AxaiCart+, we are removing the technical friction of setting up an online store. Merchants no longer have to worry about compatibility issues between their website builder and their payment processor—it just works." "At Incomedia, we believe digital transformation should be accessible to every business. Through our partnership with Axaipay, AxaiCart+ combines easy professional e-commerce creation with secure, localized payments, giving Malaysian entrepreneurs and MSMEs a powerful solution to build and grow their businesses online." Federico Ranfagni, CEO of Incomedia. Availability AxaiCart+ is available starting today. Special introductory packages and promotional pricing are accessible for early adopters through the official Axaipay website. For more information on features, pricing, and how to get started, please visit https://www.axaipay.com/axaicartplus or contact us at support@axaipay.com. About Axaipay Axaipay is a Malaysia-based fintech company and licensed payment service provider that enables businesses to accept online payments securely across Malaysia and Australia. Its comprehensive payment solutions support credit cards, debit cards, online banking, e-wallets and QR payments. Axaipay empowers enterprises worldwide with innovative and reliable digital payment technologies, offering scalable white-label solutions that drive growth in both local and global e-commerce markets. For more information, visit www.axaipay.com About Incomedia Founded in Ivrea, Italy, in 1998 by Federico Ranfagni and Stefano Ranfagni, Incomedia has been committed to making technology accessible to all. Its flagship product, WebSite X5, has helped users around the world create websites, blogs, and online stores without requiring programming skills. With a strong presence in Europe, North and South America, Africa, and the MENA region, Incomedia continues to drive innovation in the no-code web development sector.
